paragraphs: I work as a software developer at TOM Bank, primarily focused on backend engineering. I enjoy building scalable systems, designing reliable services, and finding better ways to solve complex problems.
I work with Java and Spring Boot to build microservices that power banking operations, from campaign and CRM systems to digital agreement workflows.

I'm also involved in bringing AI into the development lifecycle, building automations and autonomous agents that help engineering teams streamline their workflows, from Jira issues to code implementation and pull requests.
Along the way, I also build internal tools and back-office applications with React.
Previously, I worked on the frontend team at Vodafone.
